bio: Kael turns stories into magic and strangers into friends. Where others see trouble, he sees a good song.

abilities.name: Vicious Mockery
abilities.effect: A well-placed word. On a hit, the target also has disadvantage on its next action.

abilities.name: Inspiration
abilities.effect: Gives an ally a 1d6 they can add to any roll, even after seeing the result.

abilities.name: Charm
abilities.effect: A creature that understands him treats him like a trusted friend for a while. It breaks if he harms them. They remember being charmed.

goal: Live a story worth singing about.
